system.engine.list.title: Engine
system.engine.list.subtitle: Manage local, hybrid and remote providers. Configurable providers can have multiple engines.
system.engine.list.section.local_llm.des: Engines that run language models on this machine. They require local runtime support and usually manage model files, installation state and hardware availability.
system.engine.list.section.local_audio.d: Engines that process audio locally, such as speech-to-text or text-to-speech runtimes. They are useful when audio processing must stay on the machine.
system.engine.list.section.local_detecti: Engines that run local object detection workloads without sending data to remote providers.
system.engine.list.section.local_kg.desc: Engines that extract knowledge-graph triples locally.
system.engine.list.section.hybrid_llm.de: Engines that combine local runtime components with remote or configurable services. Use these when the provider needs both local setup and external configuration.
system.engine.list.section.remote_llm.de: Cloud or API-based language model providers. They usually require credentials or endpoint configuration instead of local model installation.
system.engine.list.section.remote_stt.de: Cloud or API-based speech-to-text providers. Use these for remote transcription services configured through provider credentials.
system.engine.list.section.remote_tts.de: Cloud or API-based text-to-speech providers. Use these for remote voice generation services configured through provider credentials.
